policy.planning: Compose a conditional access through points inside the empirically accepted support-distance bound. Isotropy and monotonic locality are explicit revisable hypotheses. Preserve exemplar and goal observations; revalidate the actual receiver at every step.
policy.domain: A bounded derived locus may supplement occurrence-centroid samples through an exact public support pixel, provenance and per-step pixel guard. The locus is a question, without an asserted outcome.
policy.scope: Single observed receiver and visible homologous enclosure. Type synthesis, several simultaneously affected receivers and interactions remain open until separately observed.

indicator.qualification: transient graphic only; physical influence remains a separate hypothesis

qualification: Only input contains replay arguments. native contains observed comparison results and must not be supplied to the original. No native state is an oracle initial condition.
